_note: Metro Sort's real AdMob app and ad units (created 2026-11-21). The test APK (Metro Sort > Build > Android APK) follows useTestAds: while it is true it requests Google's test ad units, so testing on your own phone never clicks a real ad (that can get the AdMob account suspended). The Google Play build (Android App Bundle) always requests the real units, whatever useTestAds says; add your phone as a test device in AdMob before installing that one. revenueCatGoogleApiKey is the public SDK key of the RevenueCat project Metro Sort (Play Store app); it is meant to ship inside the app. The privacy policy is the StagFunny studio policy that covers all its games.
